title: A visual-language foundation model for computational pathology

sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The accelerated adoption of digital pathology and advances in deep learning have enabled the development of robust models for various pathology tasks across a diverse array of diseases and patient cohorts.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A visual-language foundation model for computational pathology》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The accelerated adoption of digital pathology and advances in deep learning have enabled the development of robust models for various pathology tasks across a diverse array of diseases and patient cohorts.

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】However, model training is often difficult due to label scarcity in the medical domain, and a model's usage is limited by the specific task and disease for which it is trained.

evidence.text: The accelerated adoption of digital pathology and advances in deep learning have enabled the development of robust models for various pathology tasks across a diverse array of diseases and patient cohorts.
However, model training is often difficult due to label scarcity in the medical domain, and a model's usage is limited by the specific task and disease for which it is trained.
